definitions.explanation: The galaxy containing the solar system, visible as a band of light across the night sky.

examples.japanese: {銀河系|ぎんがけい}には{数千億|すうせんおく}の{星|ほし}がある。
examples.english: The Milky Way contains hundreds of billions of stars.

examples.japanese: {太陽|たいよう}は{銀河系|ぎんがけい}の{端|はし}のほうにある。
examples.english: The sun is located toward the edge of the Milky Way.

examples.japanese: {銀河系|ぎんがけい}の{中心|ちゅうしん}には{巨大|きょだい}なブラックホールがあると{考|かんが}えられている。
examples.english: It is believed that a massive black hole exists at the center of the Milky Way.

notes:
{銀河|ぎんが} (galaxy; Milky Way) + {系|けい} (system). Specifically refers to the Milky Way — the galaxy we live in. When discussing other galaxies, the term {銀河|ぎんが} alone is used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銀河系|ぎんがけい}の{中心|ちゅうしん} — the center of the galaxy
- {銀河系|ぎんがけい}の{外|そと} — outside the galaxy
- {銀河系|ぎんがけい}の{構造|こうぞう} — the structure of the galaxy

RELATED WORDS:
- {銀河|ぎんが} — galaxy; Milky Way — can refer to any galaxy or to the Milky Way poetically
- {天の川|あまのがわ} — the Milky Way — the traditional Japanese name, associated with the Tanabata festival
- {宇宙|うちゅう} — outer space; the universe
